samples.question: Each panel shows one thin wire carrying four beads. The lower wire is the same wire as the upper one after bending: the bends changed, but the total wire length and the distance of every bead measured along the wire never changed. The wire may have been turned end for end, so the lower wire can run in either direction. The upper beads are coloured, the lower beads are all gray, and exactly one lower bead is circled in black. Which colour is that circled bead in the upper panel? Answer red, blue, green, or orange.
